no-undrawn.label: Undrawn customer financing commitments, up to approximately

tel-fiber.label: Widely cited '2.7% of fiber used' is disputed: originated as a June 2001 analyst estimate for lit capacity; lit fiber about 2-5% per FDIC (2002). Fiber is a long-lived asset (decades) vs GPU useful life, which is disputed (Burry argues depreciation schedules are too long; no figure verified here).

nv-corp-exposure.label: Per a Korean news report: $99B investment assets at end-Q2 2026, $25B further investment commitments, $36B cloud service commitments, $30B OpenAI equity (Feb 2026), 10-13% CoreWeave stake and $6.3B unsold-capacity purchase commitment; Bloomberg estimate of at least $750B of announced/discussed deals. Needs 10-Q verification.
